tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Reports which AI crawlers may fetch a public URL. Reads the site's robots.txt and returns allowed or blocked, with the deciding rule, for each known AI crawler from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, Amazon and others, split into search and answer-time bots versus trainin

tools.name: check_ai_indexability
tools.description: Checks whether a public page can be indexed by search and AI engines once a crawler reaches it. Measures HTTP status and redirects, noindex, canonical target, how much copy exists in the raw HTML without JavaScript, client-side rendering signals, title and H1, XML sitemap coverage, response time, HT

tools.name: check_ai_citability
tools.description: Fetches a public page and scores how quotable its content is for AI engines once it is crawled and indexed. Measures answer-first structure, question headings, lists and tables, FAQ, paragraph and sentence length, statistic and source density, named entities, schema, author, freshness and llms.txt,

tools.name: check_seo_basics
tools.description: Fetches a public page and runs 24 measurable on-page SEO checks: title and meta description length, H1, heading hierarchy, keyword placement and density, slug, canonical, internal and external links, anchor text, image alt text, schema and social tags. Pass the target keyword to enable the keyword c

tools.name: get_review_rubric
tools.description: Returns a scoring rubric as text for the judgment items the URL tools cannot measure: geo (would an AI engine quote this article?) or seo (pre-publish SEO review). Fetches nothing.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, check_ai_indexability, get_review_rubric · Public sink: get_review_rubric.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_ai_crawler_access, check_ai_indexability, get_review_rubric · Public sink: get_review_rubric

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
